extras: Desktop only: Obsidian does not support separate windows on mobile. If your projector mirrors your screen instead of extending it, the audience sees your editor.
intentEvidence: Turn any note into a clean slide deck in a separate window, and keep editing the note while you present
problem: Presenters often struggle to switch between their detailed notes and a clean, dynamic presentation view without losing context or interrupting the flow.
summary: Converts any Obsidian note into a live, editable slide deck displayed in a separate window while allowing continuous note editing.
